tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exception for dev, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions, so no host, internal ones included, is reached over plain HTTP.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
